d: In tonight’s first programme, Mary draws on inspiration from some of her earliest and fondest memories from her childhood holidays and regular trips to the British seaside.

Like many, Christmas is Mary Berry’s favourite time of year. But all that cooking and preparation comes with a lot of pressure. No matter how many times you’ve cooked for it before, it can all seem a bit daunting.

Tonight Mary takes inspiration from the herb garden. Only dried herbs were available when Mary started cooking, but these days there is an abundance of fresh herbs that can turn an ordinary dish into something spectacular.

A golden cage of caramel encloses a sponge cake filled with wines and fruits.  Gateau in a Cage is the invention of Parisian chef Jean Deblieux, who gives Julia a private lesson in creating this stunningly dramatic dessert.
Quiche! Julia teaches you how to make an expert pie-crust dough and use it for main dish pies, such as custard and bacon, spinach and crab.

st: Chicken Dinner In Half An Hour
d: Julia Child shows you how to produce a fine feast, and do it fast.
A delicious and tender method of cooking a whole roasting chicken with wine and herbs in a covered casserole.  Serve it plain, or use its juices to produce any number of fine sauces.
Julia prepares the delicate, rich Orange Bavarian Cream.
Four French recipes with Belgian endives, including endives in a brown butter sauce and wrapped in ham, covered with a cheese sauce, and gratineed in the oven.

The search for Britain’s Best Bakery reaches the Wales and Central England final. This week’s winners must battle it out in the kitchen, creating an afternoon tea with a mix of both sweet and savoury items.
Three bakeries from Kent and Sussex go head to head.  A very British father and son team cook up some Italian passion.

The chef prepares cinnamon eggy bread with stewed apples. Youngest daughter Tilly helps with a hearty beef and ale stew, a sausage hotpot and a warming pear and ginger galette. Gordon’s Mum helps with Shepherd’s pie and a steamed date pudding.

Son Jack helps prepare a beef fillet with salsa verde, followed by chocolate and pistachio semifreddo. The chef prepares a delicious lobster linguini, and daughter Holly assists with a tasty roast chicken and hazelnut meringue tower.
Rachel Allen makes cakes with summery flavours.
The chef makes perfect treats for a house full of hungry boys.
Kirstie heads to the Highlands to visit Blair Castle's Christmas Fair and explores the wonderful world of festive Scottish craft, from handmade jewelry and fashions to pottery.

Gordon Ramsay returns for a second helping of festive cheer, inviting the nation into his family home on Christmas Day Morning he’ll share tips and expertise showing the nation how to prepare the tastiest Christmas Day menu, step by step.
The Vaughn family has been longing for holiday decorations that reflect their merry nature. Brandie, Ryan and Shannon up the ante with fun ornaments, bright colors, and bold signage full of cheer.
Host Jessica McGovern shows us how to make delightful breakfast treats like banana bread and hand pies filled with grape jelly.
Make hosting your next shower a cinch with Jessica McGovern’s simple and super cute recipes - like tiny Oatmeal Cookie Cheesecake Cups!

t: Flour Power - Twists On The Classics
d: In a special filled with Gumdrop Cakes, Gingerbread Sticky Toffee Pudding, and an Eggnog Ski Slope Cake. Flour Power Christmas: Twists on the Classics, ensures your holiday treats will never be the same!

t: Flour Power Special - Big Wow Desserts
d: From a decadent Chocolate Salted Caramel Yule Log to a whimsical Candy Cane Cake, host Jessica McGovern shows us how to celebrate a big holiday through big desserts.

t: In Julia's Kitchen with Master Chefs
d: Dean Fearing prepares shrimp diablo with Caesar salad and corn tamales.
